note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Scoop: Anthropic and OpenAI employees fear unreleased AI models are too unsafe to release
items.blurb: Over two dozen sources say staff at both labs debate keeping frontier models internal-only as capabilities grow.

items.title: Signal joins United Airlines, banks in limiting AI agents over customer risks
items.blurb: Signal restricts OS-level assistants that read screens and asks Apple, Google and Microsoft for blocking tools.

items.title: Anthropic gets $120 price target from Wedbush
items.blurb: Wedbush starts coverage at outperform as Anthropic shares briefly dip below their $83 IPO price.

items.title: Does the Nvidia-led rip mark the market bottom? Maybe not
items.blurb: Nvidia gives back part of Monday's rally, raising doubts that the AI stock sell-off has ended.

items.title: The Download: AI's gas power boom and a consciousness reality check
items.blurb: Developers have announced over 100 off-grid gas plants for US data centers as grid power runs short.

items.title: Microsoft wants "permission" to build Windows' next chapter
items.blurb: Microsoft's Windows chief says fixing Windows 11 reliability and speed comes before the next AI-heavy version.

items.title: Monday's huge stock rally was a rare event. Here's what could happen next
items.blurb: The S&P 500 jumped 4.7% Monday after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, its biggest one-day gain since April 2025.

items.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price. Traders see even more pain
items.blurb: Anthropic fell 13% Tuesday to under $76, below its $83 IPO price, as options traders bet on further declines.

items.title: Get ready for more tech outages as AI hacking threats grow
items.blurb: Cisco and OpenAI opened a project using AI agents to shield systems from new bugs while permanent patches are built.

items.title: Anthropic closes below $83 IPO price, but analysts are still largely positive
items.blurb: Anthropic fell 6.5% on Nov 24 to close below its IPO price, though most analysts starting coverage rate it a buy.

items.title: Nvidia, Jensen Huang return fuel AI credit market jitters
items.blurb: Nvidia's default-insurance costs rose after Huang's reinstatement, with CoreWeave down 13% amid worries over Nvidia-backed chip financing.

items.title: AI is 'the end of mathematics as we know it' — where does the field go next?
items.blurb: Mathematicians weigh a future where much of their profession could be delegated to AI systems that now prove theorems.

items.title: Dollar climbs as renewed AI euphoria fuels Fed hike bets
items.blurb: Renewed enthusiasm for AI stocks is feeding bets that the Federal Reserve raises rates, lifting the dollar.

items.title: How Asian countries are looking to prop up markets as AI downturn sinks stocks
items.blurb: South Korea, China and Taiwan moved to support stocks after an AI sell-off left Seoul's Kospi deep in a bear market.

items.title: U.S. probes Megaspeed, Alice Huang as new figure emerges in Nvidia chip case
items.blurb: U.S. officials confirmed an ongoing probe tied to Nvidia chips reaching China, with House interviews of Nvidia leaders set for December.

items.title: The AI data center boom is driving billions into private infrastructure
items.blurb: Infrastructure funds raised $62 billion in the third quarter, with much of the demand tied to AI data centers.

items.title: Jay Clayton to act as national cyber director until Kirsten Davies confirmed
items.blurb: The administration's AI czar will temporarily lead the office coordinating federal cybersecurity policy.

items.title: Doctors who disagree with AI could face legal jeopardy
items.blurb: Mock juries sided more often with plaintiffs when an AI disagreed with a radiologist, raising liability pressure on doctors.

items.title: Nvidia shares rise in premarket trading while Anthropic is flat after major tech sell-off
items.blurb: Investors bought AI names at a discount after the Nasdaq's 10% weekly slide; Anthropic gave back early premarket gains.

items.title: Futures rally after Wall Street's nightmare week
items.blurb: Stock futures rebounded Monday after the worst tech week since 2020, driven by doubts over AI spending.

items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, stocks rally
items.blurb: US stocks surged after Huang's return; the S&P 500 had fallen more than 9% since his Nov 12 departure.

items.title: CoreWeave, Oracle soar as Huang's return relieves Nvidia AI financing fears
items.blurb: Cloud firms that rely on Nvidia's financing backstops rebounded, with CoreWeave up 20% and Oracle up 12%.

items.title: SpaceX sued by Oregon and Virginia over AI deepfake porn, Grok safety claims
items.blurb: The first state lawsuits allege Grok enabled nonconsensual explicit images while SpaceX marketed it as safe.

items.title: The Download: AI's judgment problem and carbon removal's crop threat
items.blurb: A METR report finds models improve fast at coding but lag on tasks that need judgment.
